title: Site Footer
description: A four-column site footer with a labelled newsletter field, legal links and a service-status line.
summary: Brand, newsletter, four link groups and a status line.
notes: The newsletter form has no action and no backend. Point it at your mailing provider and handle validation and confirmation messages there.
The status line is static text. Link it to a real status page or remove it rather than leaving a permanent "All systems normal".
Link destinations, the company name and the open-roles count are placeholders.
